description: The curated list of sources: what each measures (with a plain definition), coverage, licence, whether it may be redistributed, how it is fetched (endpoint, CORS, key) and who vetted it, plus link-only pages such as Numbeo and WeatherSpark. Filter by metric or country; pass a place to get the publisher's page for it.

city.description: A city id or name in the dataset, to fill in each publisher's page for it

country.description: ISO alpha-2: only sources covering this country

metric.description: Metric id, e.g. pm25, rent_1bed, sunshine_hours

name: list_sources
title: The source registry
